purpose: Define adversarial pressure tests for V2 federation invariants: temporal privilege, semantic privilege, social privilege, and proof inflation.

attacks.description: Attempt to query federation state using latest/current semantics instead of an explicit graph root.
Attempt to make federation write obligation_met or substantive compliance instead of attestation_present.
Attempt to treat a federation epoch node as authoritative current world state.
Attempt to attach oversized or vague proof material to a predicate to create compliance fog and replay-cost inflation.

invariants: Adversarial tests must fail closed with explicit reason codes.
No attack may be represented as a valid governance action.
Proof size and predicate specificity must be bounded to prevent semantic laundering.
The harness tests grammar, write authority, social status, and replay cost.
